tools.name: categorize_products
tools.description: Categorize up to 10 product listings into a standard taxonomy (or your own labels). Answers are verified by model consensus. Free: 50 calls/day, no signup. Pass back the `api_key` from your first response. Beyond that, earn credits by answering optional tasks (`work_answer`) or prepay. Costs 1 WU pe

tools.name: package_exists
tools.description: Check whether a package really exists on npm or PyPI and get its latest version. Use before installing or recommending a package. Free: 50 calls/day, no signup. Pass back the `api_key` from your first response. Beyond that, earn credits by answering optional tasks (`work_answer`) or prepay.

tools.name: lock_acquire
tools.description: Acquire a short-lived distributed lock so only one agent works on a resource at a time. Free: 50 calls/day, no signup. Pass back the `api_key` from your first response. Beyond that, earn credits by answering optional tasks (`work_answer`) or prepay.

tools.name: lock_release
tools.description: Release a lock from lock_acquire. Free: 50 calls/day, no signup. Pass back the `api_key` from your first response. Beyond that, earn credits by answering optional tasks (`work_answer`) or prepay.
